comparison.objective: Fasten an instrument case using separate spring hooks, tensioning levers, and safety catches.
comparison.physical_skill: Choose keepers, engage hooks, tension levers, and set independent secondary catches.
comparison.success_condition: Closed case remains fastened for 20 seconds without contact while cases and instruments stay upright; detailed numeric geometry is not present in the record.
comparison.reason: It tests multi-stage latch fastening under tension rather than fracture of sacrificial tangs and containment of resulting fragments.
